description: Tether has more tools than the ones you see; they stay out of your context until a task needs them. Call this with a group to get its tools. Groups: devtools: the network log with request and response bodies, console output and errors, cookies. media: list and save images, video, audio and streams, grab a video frame, wait for and list downloads. watchers: check a page on a schedule and notify the user when something changes. customize: restyle a site with saved CSS, save userscripts that run on it, read and resolve change requests the user sends from the Tether popup. sites: what Tether recorded about how the user uses a site, notes kept between sessions, and flows that replay a recorded task in one call.
name: load_tools
title: Load more Tether tools
